response.basis: Derived from numbered_nl segments NL1-NL8 describing the microwave door/cooking state machine: DoorShut, DoorOpen, DoorOpenWithItem, DoorShutWithItem, ReadytoCook, Cooking states with transitions triggered by Cancel, Door Opened/Closed, item placement/removal, cooking time entry, Start action, and timer expiry.

binding_hints.reason: The microwave system as a whole is the owner of the initial edge.
DoorShut is the state entered by the initial edge.

contracts.normative_statement: The microwave system must have an initial entry edge into the DoorShut state.
contracts.quote: The microwave starts in the DoorShut state.
contracts.reason: NL1 explicitly states the microwave starts in DoorShut, establishing a required initial pseudostate edge.

contracts.basis: NL1: 'remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed'

binding_hints.reason: DoorShut is the retained state.
Cancel is the guard condition under which retention occurs.

contracts.normative_statement: When a Cancel action is performed while in DoorShut, the system must remain in DoorShut (self-loop retention).
contracts.quote: the system can either remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed
contracts.reason: NL1 explicitly requires DoorShut to be retained (self-loop) under a Cancel guard, an independently violable retention obligation distinct from the DoorOpen endpoint.

contracts.basis: NL2: 'When the Door Opened action occurs in the DoorShut state, the system transitions to the DoorOpen state.'

binding_hints.reason: DoorShut is the transition origin.
DoorOpen is the transition destination.
The Door Opened action is the named event causing this transition.

contracts.normative_statement: There must be a transition from DoorShut to DoorOpen triggered by the Door Opened action.

branches.reason: All 22 supplied NL contracts were checked against the closed FCSTM's reachability, event-consumer, and termination facts. Every state (DoorShut, DoorOpen, DoorOpenWithItem, DoorShutWithItem, ReadytoCook, Cooking) is reachable_from_initial=true per inspection_equivalent_facts.states, all 16 authored transitions resolve to exact endpoints matching the NL-required source/target/trigger relations (confirmed by exact_source_inventory + inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions), and every declared event has a reachable consumer transition/state within its full domain (event_consumers rows all show reachable_consumer_state_refs == consumer_state_refs). There is no terminal/completion state in this model (final_states=[] and no NL termination-role contract), so stable-termination auditing does not apply. No dead-end/leaf-without-outgoing fact exists (every state has outgoing_transition_refs). Therefore this lens finds no behavioral-consequence defect: no unreachable required state, no narrower-than-declared consumer coverage, no forbidden-scope entry, and no termination-state re-entry problem. Effect/action contracts (NL5-ACTION-1, NL6-EFFECT-1, NL7-ACTION-1, NL8-EFFECT-1) reference behavior carriers whose exact transitions/states exist but whose FCSTM text shows no action/effect content (parsed effects=[] and no state entry/exit action support in inspection facts); these are carried forward as predicate-null W1 candidates since they are genuine missing-content facts on exact bound carriers, consistent with the frozen predicate routing discipline for effect/state_action content that this lens must not silently drop. The guard_disjointness contract (NL4-DISJOINT-1) is preserved as a predicate-null candidate because DoorOpenWithItem's two outgoing alternatives (Door_Closed_time_0 and Enter_Cooking_Time) are both unconditional/independent named events with no guard field in the parsed FCSTM, so this lens cannot assert distinguishability failure from the closed model text alone; however since both alternatives use distinct trigger events (not the same condition), no operational indistinguishability is evidenced, so this contract is omitted as satisfied rather than raised as a defect by this lens (the sibling lens may still audit source-level guard semantics). All initial_entry and transition_endpoint contracts are satisfied by the exact FCSTM/inspection facts and are therefore omitted from candidates/unresolved.
